products.subtitle: Each product is born from a real problem. Declare your interest and help define what we build first.

devprint.descricao: Transforms your real development history — commits, PRs and manual learning logs — into a living, narrative and verifiable portfolio. Every project is proof.
devprint.descricaoLonga: Web platform that transforms a developer's real history — commits, pull requests, diffs and manual learning logs — into a living, self-updating, verifiable portfolio backed by real work evidence.
devprint.problema: Static resumes don't reflect real growth, especially for private long-term projects. Recruiters read unverifiable claims with no real evidence of what the dev learned and built.
devprint.solucao: DevPrint reads your repository, integrates manual learning logs, and updates your portfolio automatically sprint by sprint. Instead of self-declaration, the recruiter sees traceable experiences — what was learned, in which project, and with what evidence.

funcionalidades.descricao: The experience section updates automatically based on analyzed projects. Each entry comes with a traceable reference to code or the Learning Journal.
Log learnings that don't generate commits: Kanban management, PRD creation, architecture decisions, tool configuration. They appear in the timeline with the same weight as commits.
For each connected repository, the system detects what was practiced, what was newly learned, and generates a sprint timeline with narrative highlights in natural language.
Public URL at devprint.io/username. The dev controls what's visible. Private repositories never appear — only derived experiences, if authorized.

publicoAlvo: Dev without market experience who wants to prove ability with real projects
Dev transitioning stacks who needs to demonstrate what they've learned
Junior/mid dev accelerating toward senior positions
Senior dev with years of private projects not visible on GitHub

ascend.descricao: Professional growth platform for devs who want to go from junior to senior with clarity — personalized tracks, goals and progress evidence.
ascend.descricaoLonga: High-performance adaptive preparation platform for high-paying, 100% remote IT public exams and selections. Ascend matches your profile with the target vacancy requirements and generates a personalized evolution plan.
ascend.problema: Candidates study without knowing exactly what's missing. The gap between the current resume and the target position is rarely mapped precisely — the result is wasted time and energy in studying.
ascend.solucao: Ascend reads your resume, identifies the desired high-income position and automatically cross-references your data with the exam requirements to generate a skills improvement plan, postgraduate program suggestions, and alerts about common exam pitfalls.

funcionalidades.descricao: 3-step wizard: upload your professional profile, choose the target position, and generate the strategic evolution plan based on the cross-reference between profile and exam requirements.
The AI identifies exactly which skills are missing for the chosen position, prioritizing what carries the most weight in the selection process (e.g., Cebraspe).
Adaptive study plans with goals, deadlines based on the exam calendar, and progress evidence recorded throughout preparation.
Countdown to registration deadlines and alerts about recurring patterns from the chosen examining board — what's commonly tested, how questions are formulated, and where candidates most often fail.

publicoAlvo: IT professionals targeting high-paying, 100% remote public sector exams
Candidates who want to know exactly what to study, without wasting time
Devs transitioning to the public sector

elucya-talk.descricao: AIaaS solution for business communication — support automation, sentiment analysis and contextual responses with cutting-edge language models.
elucya-talk.descricaoLonga: AI-based web platform that analyzes interpersonal conversations — via audio or text — identifying patterns of toxic communication, aggression, manipulation and verbal violence, with empathetic feedback and practical Non-Violent Communication recommendations.
elucya-talk.problema: In personal, professional and family relationships, verbal conflicts escalate through unnoticed patterns. The parties involved struggle to objectively assess the dynamics, and passive aggressions or manipulations are rarely cataloged.
elucya-talk.solucao: Elucya Talk acts as an impartial AI-powered mediator: it processes audio or text, identifies participants, classifies each utterance according to behavioral patterns, calculates a Conflict Index from 0 to 100, and offers personalized educational feedback with practical NVC tips.

funcionalidades.descricao: Automatic audio-to-text conversion with speaker separation (Whisper / AssemblyAI). Each utterance is assigned to the correct participant and displayed in a chronological timeline.
Identification of: aggressive tone, threats, passive aggression, blame language, generalizations ('you always'), evasion, veiled irony, interruptions and active listening.
AI-calculated visual index representing the overall conflict level of the conversation, with highlighted peaks and most tense moments.
Individual cards with diagnosis of predominant tone, detected positive points, and practical recommendations based on Non-Violent Communication principles.

publicoAlvo: People seeking self-awareness in their communication dynamics
Couples therapists and family mediators who need objective analysis
HR managers evaluating workplace climate and harassment reports

agora-global.tagline: Democratic governance for the digital age.
agora-global.descricao: Open-source digital public governance infrastructure — citizen participation, real-time budget transparency and direct democracy for sovereign states.
agora-global.descricaoLonga: Open-source digital public governance system that transforms citizen participation and budget transparency into real pillars of the State. Each nation hosts its own sovereign instance, interoperable with a global network of digital democracies.
agora-global.problema: The main obstacle to integral human development is not technological or economic — it is the political conflict of interest that generates structural corruption, legislative inertia, and population apathy towards the direction of the State.
agora-global.solucao: Ágora Global creates a secure digital forum for citizens to propose and vote on laws, conduct real-time AI-powered budget auditing, and establish decentralized infrastructure for transparent governance — where citizens are actors, not just voters.

funcionalidades.descricao: Digital forum with sovereign identity (Zero-Knowledge Proofs), law proposals via qualified digital petitions, and real-time voting. Thematic assemblies moderated by AI synthesize opposing and supporting arguments impartially.
Machine learning algorithms cross-reference bid, invoice, and physical delivery data, detecting overpricing, diversions, and inefficiencies in real time with automatic alerts to oversight bodies.
Each country hosts and manages its own instance with full control over legislation, guidelines, and citizen privacy, maintaining optional interoperability with the global network.
Dashboard with graph and heat map visualization of every unit of public money, with 100% of spending traceable in real time to the final beneficiary or supplier.

publicoAlvo: Citizens who want real participation in public decisions
Public managers and auditors who need robust analytical tools
Open source developers committed to ethical and constitutional governance

talvrix.tagline: The falcon that spots the right opportunity before anyone else.
talvrix.descricao: SaaS platform that uses AI for intelligent matching between your resume and job listings across multiple sites, ranking results by salary and profile compatibility — in seconds.
talvrix.descricaoLonga: Talvrix automates job searching from start to finish: it extracts and structures your resume's skills via AI, scrapes jobs from configured sites, and generates a compatibility score per vacancy, ranking results by salary and profile match — in under 60 seconds.
talvrix.problema: Finding relevant vacancies is manual, fragmented and inefficient: the candidate accesses multiple sites separately, keyword searches ignore the real resume profile, there's no aggregated salary ranking across sites, and the candidate doesn't know if they're competitive before applying.
talvrix.solucao: Talvrix automates the entire process: the user uploads a PDF resume, AI extracts and structures skills, experience and seniority level, a scraper collects vacancies from configured sites, AI performs the match and generates a compatibility score per vacancy, and results are displayed ranked by salary and score.

funcionalidades.descricao: Upload your resume in PDF format. The AI automatically extracts skills, experience, seniority level, and professional profile — no manual forms.
Configure the desired job sites (LinkedIn, Indeed, Gupy, etc.) and Talvrix automatically collects relevant opportunities in real time.
Each vacancy receives a compatibility score calculated by AI based on your profile. Know before applying whether you're competitive for the role.
Results are ranked by salary and profile match score. The best opportunities appear first — no noise, no manual effort.

publicoAlvo: Devs seeking relocation who want to find well-paying tech jobs without wasting time
Senior professionals looking for positions matching their experience, without manual filtering
Recent graduates who want to understand where they fit in the market
Any professional who wants to automate searching across multiple sites simultaneously

kairos-labs.descricao: Institutional portal and demand validation hub. The registered brand that unites all solutions — and the starting point for the future of the ecosystem.
kairos-labs.descricaoLonga: Institutional portal, innovation showcase and demand data validation hub for the Kairos Labs technology solutions ecosystem. Registered trademark at INPI (Process No. 944610498, Class 42), operating as the meeting point between the founder, the products, and the market.
kairos-labs.problema: Multi-product ecosystems need a point of presence that proves commercial existence, showcases the portfolio under construction, and collects real demand data to prioritize what should be developed first.
kairos-labs.solucao: Kairos Labs functions as the parent brand: ensures registered public presence, clearly presents each ecosystem product, captures segmented waitlists by product, and delivers the founder a private analytics dashboard for data-driven decisions.

funcionalidades.descricao: Interactive cards for each ecosystem product with status, description, tagline, and early access button — allowing the market to declare interest before launch.
Each product has its own waitlist. The interested party's email is linked to the corresponding product_id, generating precise demand data per solution.
Private panel protected by Supabase Auth with real-time KPIs: total subscribers, demand ranking by product, weekly growth, and lead table with CSV export.
Institutional presence with logo display, INPI badge (Process No. 944610498) and public engineering history on GitHub — demonstrating technical maturity to recruiters and tech leads.

publicoAlvo: Technical recruiters and tech leads evaluating code quality and architecture
Potential clients and beta testers for each ecosystem product
Founder (Cesar Pizarro) for roadmap decisions based on real demand
